title: "So Much for ‘Liquidity Enhancement’"

Australian Office of Financial Management head [Neil Hyden](http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/business/story/0,28124,25011273-643,00.html "Neil Hyden") gives the game away on the government’s expanded bond issuance program:

> *“The bonds we’re issuing, the proceeds are all going to be needed for government expenditures…”*
